title: Capability request
description: A request to use a capability. It is a request, and the schema is built so it cannot be mistaken for a grant. The grant is a separate object issued by the Kernel (contracts/capability-grant.schema.json) after the Consequence Gate revalidates at commit time.

capability_id.description: Must be advertised by the Capability Discovery Service. An unadvertised id is refused, never created on demand.

legal_principal.description: A real accountable party. UNIIMENTE is infrastructure and may never be named here.

grant_reference.description: The Kernel-issued grant authorizing this request, or null. Null is valid on the request and is refused at the Gate for anything above internal_write.

then.description: Financial and irreversible requests may not carry a null grant even as a request.
